answer: Each grader agent logs a signed vote vector each epoch and the network aggregates a mutual‑information matrix across all agents, mapping how often any pair’s binary choices co‑occur in the same pattern. When a subset repeatedly yields an umber‑high correlation—like an orchard of identical trees in a canyon—its joint entropy falls below a threshold, the protocol automatically flags the cluster and requires each member to stake a bond proportional to the detected similarity.
